capabilities: check off daily routine tasks in a Today sidebar
schedule tasks per weekday within a routine
track scheduled-day streaks with corrections and monthly freezes
embed habit-board, weekday-pattern, and calendar heatmap views in notes
export a JSON snapshot for a read-only Scriptable iPhone widget
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian Community plugin directory; manual ZIP installation is required until approval. Physical iOS and Android testing is unverified, and the Scriptable widget screenshots are design mockups. Data is stored in the plugin's data.json; users are told to back up the vault to preserve habit history.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track recurring habits and routines with streaks, schedules, and completion history inside the vault.

relations.evidence: The streak board and palette are inspired by Everyday.
Use Daymark Today, the optional read-only Home Screen companion, to see your completed count

requires.name: Scriptable (iOS app, only for the optional home-screen widget)

summary: Habit tracker that checks off routine tasks in a Today sidebar, tracks scheduled-day streaks, and embeds heatmap boards in notes.
